cards.title: Equal depths have no guaranteed order.
cards.excerpt: ⚠ Equal depths have no guaranteed order. Like XNA, the sorting modes use an unstable sort (CNA reproduces XNA’s own quicksort on purpose), so sprites that share the same layerDepth may come out in a different relative or
Deferred — submission order wins; layerDepth is ignored. Real XNA 4.0 output, recorded as pixel-identical to CNA's DIRECTX9 renderer.
BackToFront — the deepest sprite is drawn first, so a different sprite finishes on top. Real XNA 4.0 output, recorded as pixel-identical to CNA's DIRECTX9 renderer.
FrontToBack — here the sort is a no-op and the frame is byte-identical to Deferred . Real XNA 4.0 output, recorded as pixel-identical to CNA's DIRECTX9 renderer.

The baseline scene — the default Greater test at the reference alpha keeps the two left regions and clips the rest. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA's DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel. That is a DIRECTX9 statement: i
Always — every fragment passes, so all four regions survive regardless of alpha. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
Never — every fragment is discarded, leaving only the clear colour. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
Less — the exact inverse of the baseline: only the low-alpha regions survive. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
LessEqual — adds the region sitting exactly at the reference alpha to what Less keeps. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
Equal — only the one region whose alpha is exactly the reference value survives. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
GreaterEqual — the usual cutout-foliage setting; keeps everything at or above the threshold. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.
NotEqual — the complement of Equal : the single region at the reference alpha is the only one clipped. Real XNA 4.0 output; CNA’s DIRECTX9 renderer matches it pixel-for-pixel.

links.label: 🚀 Getting Started Quick introduction to CNA - what it is, prerequisites, first build (from the next branch, with sharp-runtime's next branch), and a minimal game skeleton. Start here

🌐 Platforms Target support plus the independent host-platform selections (SDL3, SDL2, native X11, Wayland and Win32, Headless, Terminal) and audio selections (SDL3, SDL2, Null, ALSA).

🖥 Native Platforms The X11, Wayland and Win32 platform layers that use no SDL: capabilities, build requirements, the CNA_ENABLE_SDL switch, ALSA audio and what CI actually covers. New in this snapshot

🎨 Graphics Renderers Comparison and guide for all 25 selectable renderers - the EasyGL OpenGL ES 2/3, OpenGL 3.3 and WebGL family, OpenGL 4, Vulkan, SDL_GPU, SDL_Renderer, native Direct3D 9/11/12 with Direct2D and GDI, Metal, FNA3D, FreeDirect, browser WebGL/Canvas/SVG/DOM, experimental WebGPU, and the GPU-free Headless, Software, PortableGL and Stub renderers - maturity tiers, test coverage, tradeoffs and when to use each.
⇄ Runtime Renderer Selection Opt-in multi-renderer builds, precedence, latching on the first successfully created renderer, explicit fallback, combination rules and diagnostics.

C Experimental Native C API ABI 0.29.0 (alpha.1: 0.7.0) source surface: 61 headers, 4,055 routes, measured inventory, intended package design and a release gate that still reads "Not ready". No CI job builds the library, and alpha.1's renderer-map compile blocker no longer exists in the source.

⚙ XNA Compatibility API coverage against the XNA 4.0 runtime - 331 of 331 documented types and 3,627 of 3,627 members are represented - what that does and does not prove, and where "present" does not mean "working".

✨ Effects System Built-in effects reference: BasicEffect, AlphaTestEffect, DualTextureEffect, EnvironmentMapEffect, SkinnedEffect, custom ShaderEffect, and compiled XNA effect bytecode (14 of the 25 renderer identities).
🖼 SpriteBatch Complete SpriteBatch guide covering Begin overloads, Draw overloads, SpriteSortMode, and BlendState configuration.
🎵 Audio System Audio API reference: SoundEffect, SoundEffectInstance, MediaPlayer, Song, the functional XACT runtime, and the SDL3, SDL2, Null and ALSA audio implementations.
🎮 Input System Input handling guide for Keyboard, Mouse, GamePad, and TouchPanel across all supported platforms.
🔢 Math Types Math type reference: Vector2, Vector3, Vector4, Matrix, Quaternion, BoundingBox, Curve, and related utilities.
🗻 Roadmap Detailed development roadmap - what shipped since alpha.1, what is partial, what remains open, and the long-term vision.
❓ FAQ Frequently asked questions about CNA, its goals, differences from FNA/MonoGame, and how to contribute.
🎭 3D Rendering Vertex buffers, primitives, cameras, and the 3D pipeline.
⚖ Graphics State BlendState, DepthStencilState, RasterizerState, SamplerState.
🖼 Render Targets RenderTarget2D, RenderTargetCube, and multiple render targets.
🎨 Shader Effects Writing renderer-native GLSL/SPIR-V shaders with ShaderEffect. This is separate from the renderer-qualified XNA Effect Framework bytecode (compiled effects) path.
📦 ContentManager Asset loading with Load<T>(). Prefers a .xnb when one exists, then a .cnb, and falls back to loose files.
🗃 XNB Loading & Interoperability Reading and writing .xnb binaries: 61 type readers, a real LZX decompressor and encoder, and the honest gaps.
🏠 Model Loading The gltf_to_cnj and .cnb pipelines, XNB models, and the CNAEXT skeletal animation layer.
🔄 Game Loop & Lifecycle Game, GameTime, GameComponent, and fixed vs variable timestep.
🔢 PackedVector Types All 17 packed vector types, with IEEE 754 half-float precision.
💾 Storage StorageDevice and StorageContainer for save games and user data.
🎬 Video Playback VideoPlayer and Song. Optional FFmpeg backend (Linux and macOS); the Video types link everywhere and throw NotSupportedException without it.
📱 Sensors Accelerometer and Gyroscope over the real SDL3 sensor API, Compass and Motion over the Android NDK, plus VibrateController.
⚖ CNA vs Alternatives Honest comparison against FNA, MonoGame, and original XNA.
📂 Migration from MonoGame / XNA Porting an existing C# game: asset conversion, property renaming, ownership patterns.

⚡ CNAEXT Engine Layer The opt-in CNA::Graphics engine layer (98 headers): render pipeline, post-process passes, shadows, lighting, IBL, compute, particles and shader packages, with renderer requirements and stability caveats. New in this snapshot

🧩 Framework.Design The XNA Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Design type converters (13 types) in the opt-in CNA::Design module: what they do, how to register them and what is out of scope. New in this snapshot

🏭 Content Pipeline The build-time pipeline: cna-content , importers and processors, the XNA-shaped Content.Pipeline API, cna_add_content , and how .cnb and .xnb outputs are produced. New in this snapshot
📁 CNB Format CNA's own deterministic runtime container: header, table of contents, CRC-32C checksums, chunk and asset-type ids, schemas and read limits. New in this snapshot
🔧 Command-Line Tools Reference for cna-content , the .cnb and glTF converters, cna_tool_cnb_info , the XNB fixture generator and the Inspector bridge. New in this snapshot
📊 Diagnostics The opt-in CNA_DIAGNOSTICS layer: counters, gauges, frame statistics, CPU profiler zones, bounded recording and Chrome-trace export, with its overhead and limits. New in this snapshot
🔍 Inspector The view-only Inspector: an in-process agent, the cna-inspector bridge and its offline browser UI, with the security model and how to enable it. New in this snapshot

stats.title: 2,877 commits (713 first-parent, 47 merges) between tag v0.1.0-alpha.1 (1bb2145d, 20 Aug 2026) and snapshot 009d40f5 (24 Sep 2026)

stats.label: Renderer identities
stats.title: 25 public identities over 21 implementation families; the five OpenGL/WebGL identities share one EasyGL family. Unknown or unsupported names stop the CMake configure step.

stats.label: Platform implementations
stats.title: CNA_PLATFORM: SDL3 (default), SDL2, X11, Wayland, Win32, Headless and POSIX Terminal. X11, Wayland and Win32 are native backends that do not use SDL.

stats.label: Audio platform choices
stats.title: CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM: SDL3, SDL2, ALSA and Null. SDL3 and ALSA enable the XNA playback mixer (SOUND_ENABLED); SDL2 and Null are device-level surfaces only.

stats.label: Static test definitions
stats.title: Across 904 CNA-owned C++ test sources (871 contain macros); vendored third_party sources excluded. 879 standalone renderer pixel programs are not counted. Definitions are not executed cases and no CTest total is published.

stats.label: XNA runtime members represented
stats.title: Representation only: every documented XNA 4.0 runtime member (331/331 types) has a declaration in CNA's public headers, measured by tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py. It does not claim behavioral parity.

stats.label: XNA samples complete
stats.title: External repository, pinned: cna-samples @ 4da98a0 (2026-09-20) marks 87 of 153 upstream sample directories complete; 40 are published as browser builds. Not a result for CNA snapshot 009d40f5.

stats.label: CI workflow files
stats.title: Workflow files (28 jobs), not passing lanes. The Direct3D and GDI Windows lanes are manual; no workflow runs the XNA oracle corpus, a Wayland session or a C API build.
